grade.basis: All 28 PDF pages inspected, including all 25 notation pages and three complete movements. Score is unusually written in treble clef for all eight viola staves (individual eighth part also supplied in alto/bass layouts). Mostly single-line writing in ordinary low/middle register; dotted compound-meter patterns at dotted-quarter 116, accents/offbeats, chromatic blues notes and quick arco/pizzicato changes determine the challenge. Slow Blues Song needs sustained bow control; De Stille at quarter124 uses repeated rhythmic figures. Viola1/5 upper melodic line slightly leads difficulty; no extreme register, extended techniques or elaborate double stopping. Upper intermediate 3, adjacent2–4 plausible. Advisory teaching estimate against data/source/levels.json, approximately one level either side; no automatic uplift for ensemble size.
